Fix the running status identifier so users can match it to deployment history.

## Changes

The pull request adds a running deployment status line that displays an abbreviated revision and the attempt number.

## Important

- app/display.py:13 — comments — Use the history revision identifier in running status — For revision `0123456789abcdef`, `status()` displays `0123456` while `history()` displays `0123456789ab`. The docstring promises “the same identifier as history,” but `status()` uses `revision[:7]` and `history()` uses `revision[:12]`. — For revisions longer than seven characters, users cannot match running and historical deployments by the identifier shown. — Fix: Extend `test_running_status_contains_attempt` to check the revision identifier as well as the attempt number.
